purpose: Connect Reddit reception and the primary proof claim to ongoing ROOT0 SG-001 through SG-016 constructive mathematical work and hypotheses about publication lag, semantic distillation, and authorship governance.

tracks.name: time_dilation
tracks.definition: Use measured date gaps and publication lag; distinct from physical relativistic time dilation

observations.event: First dated internal research step reported in Alpöge PDF

tracks.method: Keep three clocks separate: source authorship/commit time, reported model interaction time, public announcement time; infer no causal transfer from earlier date alone

tracks.name: distillation
tracks.definition: Operational invariants may survive changes in nomenclature or mathematical representation
observations: SG-001 to SG-016 define post-hoc constructive transformations toward finite Weil and theta-like structures
Primary PDF reports a toy model, Fourier analysis, multiplicity, iterated theta lifts and an internally produced long Lean text
tracks.method: Compare actual transformations, explicit input-output pairs and independently dated source ancestry; use counterexamples and avoid training-data attribution from analogy

tracks.name: tos_authorship
tracks.definition: Separate legal rights, data training permissions, scientific contribution, paper byline and acknowledgements
observations: Primary PDF explicitly credits human steering and Claude technical contribution; mentions an announcement constraint involving leadership; specific agreement unspecified
Anthropic publicly distinguishes consumer settings and commercial data use; user-specific settings and researcher employment arrangements unknown
Reddit presents commentary, not primary legal evidence
tracks.method: Freeze official dated Terms and policy sections; identify product/account/employment context; only assert infringement or deliberate avoidance on documented attributable evidence

next_math_bound: SG-017 projective cocycle and global phase consistency in finite Sp6 action; preserve separate from social/lineage claims
limitations: Do not equate distillation with confirmed model training exposure
Do not infer contract intent from announcement delay or byline
Exact coefficient overlap with external Lean proof untested
No statistical causal analysis of corpus authorship
